== March 22, 2011 ==
* Split skill into separate [[Fevered Dreams|PvE]] and [[Fevered Dreams (PvP)|PvP versions]].
{{clear}}

== May 21, 2010 ==
* Increased recharge to 10 seconds.
* The Dazed condition is now applied both at the time this hex is cast–if the target has 2 or more conditions–and whenever the target receives 2 or more conditions.
{{clear}}

== December 11, 2008 ==
* Functionality changed to: "For {{gr|10|25}} seconds, whenever target foe suffers from a new condition, all foes in the area suffer from that condition as well and if that foe has two or more conditions that foe is Dazed for {{gr|1|3}} seconds."
{{clear}}

== March 2, 2006 ==
* Increased [[duration]] to {{gr|10|25}} seconds.

== September 7, 2005 ==
* Fixed '''Fevered Dreams''' so that it doesn't spread [[condition]]s to [[Ally|allies]].
{{clear}}

== June 1, 2005 ==
* Fixed [[skill]] '''Fevered Dreams''' so that it does not affect non-[[foe]] [[target]]s in response to unsourced [[condition]] effects.
